scope: CVG-004 bounded durable Vetus import idempotency and reconciliation integrity

criteria.description: Canonical migration 0149 adds nullable, lowercase SHA-256 request fingerprints to Vetus import logs and batches without rewriting historical migrations or data.
criteria.limitations: Migration application was verified only on a fresh disposable PostgreSQL database; production migration execution remains open.

criteria.description: Normalized single and batch payloads persist internal fingerprints, exact source-reference replays are idempotent, divergent replays and item conflicts return stable 409 responses, and request hashes are omitted from public summaries.
criteria.limitations: Legacy rows with NULL fingerprints remain replay-compatible; no backfill or external Vetus reconciliation is claimed.

criteria.description: Source-reference acquisition uses the existing tenant database transaction with a transaction-scoped advisory lock, row lock and the existing unique indexes; two API instances and cross-tenant isolation are covered.
criteria.limitations: Concurrency evidence is local disposable PostgreSQL with two API runtimes; target connection, pool and deployment behavior remain open.

criteria.description: Batch dry-run, rejected-row persistence, immutable partial resume, original row identity, rollback of only batch-created participants and response-size protection are enforced before and during mutation.
criteria.limitations: The bounded contract does not establish full Vetus batch behavior or target-environment rollback acceptance.

criteria.description: Commit and rollback recovery refreshes owners, patients and audit for the affected account; refreshes are serialized per account and all sibling snapshots settle before the queue advances.
criteria.limitations: The cache test is deterministic in-process evidence; distributed cache invalidation and target observability remain outside scope.

criteria.description: The bounded implementation passes focused regression, full API, workspace typecheck/lint, official coverage and repository security/contract validators.
criteria.limitations: Repository-local quality and security controls do not certify target infrastructure, remote CI, production operations, accessibility or release readiness.

criteria.description: Independent review findings were addressed with RED/GREEN regression evidence, and a final independent read-only review returned PASS_BOUNDED without current HIGH or MEDIUM findings; global parity remains explicitly unpromoted.
criteria.limitations: This is not a complete Vetus parity, enterprise readiness or release gate.

criteria.description: The existing assisted-import UI is exercised through real browser authentication against the SPA, API and disposable PostgreSQL: validation, durable dry-run, import, participant reads and UI rollback are verified, including inactive persisted owner/patient statuses after rollback.
criteria.limitations: Evidence is limited to the canonical local runner with seeded tenants, disposable PostgreSQL/Redis and Chromium. It does not certify external Vetus behavior, target deployment, provider homologation, accessibility or release acceptance.

gaps: CVG-004 parent parity remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL: general Vetus parity is 98/100 with 4/11 areas verified.
Clinical parity remains 100/100 with 2/3 areas verified; laboratory provider and homologation remain open.

External Vetus/Live Pet/Live Lab connectors, provider/target behavior, distributed worker failure/observability, backup/restore, remote CI, accessibility, operations and release acceptance remain open; only the local seeded browser composition is covered by V-008.
conditions: Keep the request fingerprint internal; do not expose or log it as a public API field.
Revalidate before any backfill, external import reconciliation, provider/target operation, deployment, production or release action.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded durable Vetus import idempotency and reconciliation integrity
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, one additive canonical migration and disposable PostgreSQL/authenticated HTTP verification for internal source-payload fingerprints, divergent source-reference conflicts and transaction-safe acquisition. Exclude external Vetus/Live Pet/Live Lab, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before external import reconciliation, backfill, provider/target operation, credential handling, production/deployment or release action.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL. Select the next separately authorized gap; do not promote this result to full Vetus parity, enterprise readiness or release.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to Vetus import identity, owner/patient persistence composition, cache recovery or rollback semantics
Changes to migrations 0098/0102 or the additive fingerprint migration
Any external Vetus/Live Pet/Live Lab integration, backfill, provider, target, credential, production, deployment or release expansion
